# <c-be9000>B</c><c-c29710>e</c><c-c69e1b>t</c><c-caa525>t</c><c-ceab2d>e</c><c-d2b236>r</c> <c-d6b93e>G</c><c-dac045>a</c><c-dec74d>u</c><c-e2ce55>n</c><c-e6d55d>t</c><c-eadc64>l</c><c-eee36c>e</c><c-f2ea74>t</c><c-f6f17c>s</c>
The <cy>ultimate</c> Gauntlet rewrite; bringing the Gauntlets to <cg>life</c>! Truly giving a <c-fcee76>**Better Gauntlet**</c> experience!

---

## Features
- <c-be9000>Reworked UI</c>!
- <c-ceab2d>Brand new navigation</c>!
- <c-dec74d>Custom Gauntlets</c>!
- <cg>__And more to come__</c>!

---

## Recommendations
These mods are recommended you download to <cp>further enhance</c> the liveliness of the Gauntlets:

<mod:arcticwoof.gauntlets_deluxe>

---

## Notes
- LGBTQIA+ Rights are human rights. You are not alone in this fight. Stay strong.

---

## Credits
- **[Dasshu](user:1975253)**: Better Gauntlets' developer
- **[LimeGradient](user:7214334)**: Initial setup and early help
- **[Capeling](user:18226543)**: Early filespace development, bugfixes, pointing out that i'm dumb
- **[Erymanthus](user:1941705)**: Bugfixes

---

## Special Thanks
- **The Globed Staff Team** - For being great friends and overall supportive of my endeavors.
- **The Geode Discord** - For answering my REALLY stupid and simple-minded questions.
changelog:
# <cc>v2.0.9</c>
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> Level rewards (crystals, coins) not being granted on gauntlet level completion (i hope)...</c>
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> Forgotten Gauntlet icons looking too small on certain devices.</c>
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> Coins possibly zero-ing out on account sync to Better Gauntlets' server.</c>

---

## v2.0.8
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> Account caching/fetching process EVEN FURTHER.</c>
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> the Forgotten Gauntlets toggle to show proper list status when exiting a custom Gauntlet.</c>
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> a rare bug where the Gauntlets Deluxe button would not appear.</c>
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> possible rate limit issues.</c>
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> the Forgotten Gauntlet's scrollbar scale being inaccurate.</c>

---

## v2.0.7
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> Argon verification *further*.</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> The Gauntlet Keeper's requirements from the Doom Gauntlet to just 10 Gauntlets total.</c>
    - Their dialog updates with your Gauntlet progress!</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> the Leaderboard to have placement numbers for the Top 100 players.</c>

---

## v2.0.6
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> Argon to now handle dead tokens accordingly.</c>

---

## v2.0.5
- <c-f2fff2><cg>**Added**</c> **[Better Touch Prio](mod:alk.better-touch-prio)** as a dependency.</c>
    - This fixes the scrolling and button clicking on all devices due to touch prio mis-match.
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> Leaderboard icon caching AGAIN to use Better Gauntlets' servers instead of RobTop's.</c>
    - If you have any issue regarding rate limiting, please let me know!

<c-33333b>Hey, down here! Click the Forgotten Gauntlets title!</c>

---

## v2.0.4
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> support for Gauntlets Deluxe.</c>
    - Used the wrong ID, oops!

---

## v2.0.3
- <c-f2fff2><cg>**Added**</c> support for **[Gauntlets Deluxe](mod:arcticwoof.gauntlets_deluxe)**!</c>
- <c-fff2f2><cr>**Removed**</c> the Leaderboard button ***temporarily***.</c>

## Known Issues:
- The Leaderboard is bound to rate limit the user for an hour when clicking. <cr>This is NOT intentional.</c> It has been removed until the issue can be solved.
---

## v2.0.2
- <c-f2fff2><cg>**Added**</c>: "New Gauntlet Button Texture" setting.</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> the Gauntlet Keeper's dialog images and speech.</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> Leaderboard icon caching method for real this time I hope...</c>

---

## v2.0.1
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> Leaderboard icon caching method.</c>
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> Forgotten Gauntlet sprites being bigger on lower-quality devices.</c>
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> Forgotten Gauntlet requirement to match Gauntlet Keeper dialog. Oops.</c>

---

## v2.0.0
- <c-c4ffff><cj>**Bump**</c> to Geode v5.9.0</c>
- <c-f2fff2><cg>**Added**</c> The Forgotten Gauntlets!</c>
    - Finally we no longer need to rely on RobTop to add new Gauntlets, as Better Gauntlets' **Gauntlet Managers** can now create official-quality *custom Gauntlets* with ease! These new Gauntlets can be mixed in gameplay type to create a unique Gauntlet experience!
    - To celebrate the release of Better Gauntlets v2.0.0 and the capabilities for new Gauntlets, the **Stellar** and **Lunar** Gauntlets are now available to play! Select the star next to the layer title ("The Lost Gauntlets") to see them!
- <c-f2fff2><cg>**Added**</c> Slider navigation to the Gauntlets!</c>
    - All gauntlets now load on one scrollable page instead of three per-page. Use either dragging or the scroll bar at the bottom of the screen to navigate the Gauntlets.
- <c-f2fff2><cg>**Added**</c> a new collectable, "Crystals"!</c>
    - A new form of collectable granted by completing The Forgotten Gauntlets' levels.
- <c-f2fff2><cg>**Added**</c> a new collectable, "(Gauntlet) Coins"!</c>
    - A new form of collectable granted by completing The Forgotten Gauntlets.
- <c-f2fff2><cg>**Added**</c> Global Leaderboards!</c>
    - Check your Crystal and Coin count and compare them to other Better Gauntlets players around the world!
- <c-f2fff2><cg>**Added**</c> Account Sync!</c>
    - Sync your Forgotten Gauntlet collectable stats cross-client *without* needing to save/load your game data! Use the "Sync" button in the Global Leaderboards to sync your account to Better Gauntlets.
- <c-f2fff2><cg>**Added**</c> Profile Badges!</c>
    - Using the Badgified API, badges can now be set on managers and helpers' profiles to indicate managerial status.
    - Badges for *Supporters* can also be set! Donate *$5 USD* or more to get the badge.
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c>: `GauntletSelectLayer` now uses the `BetterGauntletSelectLayer` class!</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c>: `GauntletLayer` now uses the `BetterGauntletLayer` class!</c>
    - With these class changes, Better Gauntlets no longer relies on RobTop's vanilla Gauntlet layers, and can be easily updated when a new version of Geode and/or Geometry Dash releases!
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> Gauntlet Info to be paged.</c>
    - Information between "The Lost Gauntlets" and "The Forgotten Gauntlets" will be separated by pages as to not stir confusion.
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> Gauntlet reload button.</c>
    - The reload button now affects the visible Gauntlet list as to not cause rate limiting on RobTop's servers.
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> "The Lost Gauntlets" title sprite.</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> GauntletNode completion visuals.</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> GauntletNode Background colors to fade between BG and Name color.</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> `CreatorLayer` to show a new Gauntlet button texture!</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> Gauntlet Levels to show a new custom unlock animation!</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> Gauntlet rewards to be claimed automatically upon completion!</c>
- <c-fffff2><cy>**Updated**</c> support for the following Gauntlets:</c>
  - `Water, Monster, Discord`
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> Gauntlet Level fields (name, author, stars) not appearing on level unlock.</c>
- <c-f2faff><cl>**Fixed**</c> GDPS previews being locked, and/or crashing on Gauntlet preview.</c>
- <c-fff2f2><cr>**Removed**</c> Rescale Loading Circle setting.</c>

## Known Issues:
- The new Gauntlet icons added by Better Gauntlets may not show up all the time, this is due to rate limiting and personal internet speeds. If you would like to support this mod and help fund the server's upkeep, please consider donating to my Kofi or Boosty!
- GDUtils' "New Gauntlet Design" setting **does not work** with this update, and that is intentional. Measures have been taken to make sure the setting does not apply due to the modifications made to `GauntletNode`. Does this count as an incompatability? Maybe. Do I care? No :P
- New or existing mods that hook either `GauntletSelectLayer` and/or `GauntletLayer` must now hook to `BetterGauntletSelectLayer` and `BetterGauntletLayer` for their mods' changes to be reflected in-game.

<c-33333b>*The Gauntlet Keeper grows tired of waiting.*</c>

---
